elements.description:
Where an answer's uncertainty comes from: the mix of kinds with their shares and meanings and a reading of what to
do, beside a breakdown chart of the same mix per part of the answer.

properties.name: sources
properties.description: Where the uncertainty comes from: a part, a kind's key and an amount each

properties.name: kinds
properties.default: [ { key: "gap", label: "Missing information", meaning: "More information would narrow it", advice: "Find or request what's missing before relying on it.", color: "var(--tc-tone-violet-solid)", }, { key: "chance", label: "Inherent uncertainty", meaning: "The outcome isn't decided yet", advice: "Watch for early signs and revisit as things change.", color: "var(--tc-status-info-solid)", }, { key: "model", label: "Model limits", meaning: "At the edge of what the model knows", advice: "Check it with a person who knows the area, or a primary source.", color: "var(--tc-tone-amber-solid)", }, ]
properties.description: The kinds, in display order – defaultUncertaintyKinds by default

properties.name: parts
properties.description: The parts in display order – by first appearance in `sources` by default

properties.name: partLabel
properties.description: What a part is called, e.g. "Section" or "Claim"

properties.name: hiddenKinds
properties.description: Keys of the kinds hidden from the chart and the reading

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: The line under the heading, e.g. the question the answer is to

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-hidden-change
events.description: Kinds were hidden or shown in the chart's legend ({ hidden, hiddenKinds }: UncertaintyHiddenChange – both the kinds' keys); cancelable – prevented, `hiddenKinds` stays

functions.name: defaultUncertaintyKinds
functions.description: Missing information, inherent uncertainty and model limits

props.name: title
props.description: The reading card's heading – "Uncertainty mix" by default

props.name: hidden
props.description: Keys of the kinds hidden from the chart and the reading (controlled)

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Called when the chart's legend hides or shows kinds

changelog: All 18 blocks are now elements – `tc-agent-gallery`, `tc-ai-side-pane`, `tc-ai-workspace`, `tc-app-directory`, `tc-client-context`, `tc-evidence-gallery`, `tc-header-nav`, `tc-invoice-credit`, `tc-kpi-board`, `tc-logo-marquee`, `tc-metrics-dashboard`, `tc-oversight-home`, `tc-pricing-plans`, `tc-publish-readiness`, `tc-red-team-finding`, `tc-task-board`, `tc-testimonial-wall`, `tc-uncertainty-mix` – so Angular (`trenchcoat/angular`), Vue, Svelte, plain HTML and generative UI get them like any component, with docs pages.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
